documentation_update_rules.rationale: A new module is a new roadmap layer and a new label. The module indexes and status tables all go stale at once

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a **new service, port, script, bucket, or committed config file** inside an existing module
documentation_update_rules.references:
`docs/agent/MODULE-ITEM-MATRIX.md`
that module's `setup/automated.md` if it changes what is scripted
documentation_update_rules.rationale: The item matrix is read instead of re-deriving "what does this module own". An addition missing from it is invisible to the next session

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a module's **manual setup steps are actually walked** and something does not match — a renamed setting, a tool that no longer ships that option, a step that turns out unnecessary
documentation_update_rules.references:
that module's `setup/manual.md` (dated correction)
`docs/SETUP-TECHNIQUE-NOTES.md` if it is general friction, not module-specific
`docs/agent/MODULE-MATRIX.md` if the real cost diverged from its row
documentation_update_rules.rationale: A setup doc is a spec until someone walks it; after that it should read as what is true

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a module's row in `CLAUDE.md` §11 changes status
documentation_update_rules.rationale: Subjects cite the §11 row **verbatim**. `validate` fails loudly on drift — this is the one rule with real enforcement, and it fails rather than warns

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a **new service** in `docker-compose.yml`, or a port/profile change
documentation_update_rules.references:
`docs/agent/MODULE-ITEM-MATRIX.md`
`Makefile` (target for a new profile)
the owning module's `setup/automated.md`
`.env.example` if it adds a variable
documentation_update_rules.rationale: The item matrix is the port map. `AUDIT.md` **used to** record six Compose-referenced values missing from `.env.example` (fixed `P-016`/`P-035`, 2026-09-01/02) — this is the rule that stops a seventh from recurring

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a **new or removed** `.json` under any `workflows/` directory
documentation_update_rules.rationale: Both workflow indexes **used to have** listed files that did not exist. The verified on-disk tables were the fix, and `tests/realtime_ai/test_workflows.py` now checks the index against disk automatically — this rule is what to update when the check would otherwise fail

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a new model or weight requirement in any module
documentation_update_rules.rationale: `models.md` is the single inventory across four consuming modules. A weight documented only in one module's prose is invisible to the others
Anchors match exact heading text. `validate` fails on drift — proven 2026-08-30 when a README rename broke it

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a subject's `icps` or `status` changes in `subjects/stream-extend.yml` or `subjects/content-extend.yml`, a marketing profile, persona or show changes in `configs/local/stream-programming.yaml`, or `engine_order` changes in `assets.yml`
documentation_update_rules.rationale: The playbook repeats these on purpose so a human can read the plan. `tests/marketing_crosswalk/test_playbook.py` fails when a copy drifts, so a stale playbook cannot ship quietly

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a module gains or loses a capability, or a **manual** check becomes automatable
documentation_update_rules.rationale: The acceptance checklist defines "done"; the subfeature roll-up exposes implementation and evidence separately. A capability with no line can never be verified, and a manual line that is now automated is a step people keep doing by hand for no reason

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a **new kind of change** with no row in `VERIFICATION-MATRIX.md` — a new language, service, file type, or tool
documentation_update_rules.rationale: The matrix is what "verified locally" means. A change type with no row is one nobody knows how to prove, so it gets claimed rather than checked

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a proposal is **added**, or an existing one gains an **owner decision** or a **run only a person or hardware can do**
documentation_update_rules.rationale: Owner decisions and live runs were found scattered across twelve proposals on 2026-10-04 with no single list. The lanes are a derived index, and an index nobody updates is the failure this matrix already names for itself

documentation_update_rules.references:
the doc named in that row
that proposal's rows in `docs/todo/` — they must already be resolved
documentation_update_rules.rationale: The queue tracks state; the linked doc holds the content. A `Done` row pointing at a doc that never received the decision loses the decision

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a proposal is added, its scope changes, or its agent model changes
documentation_update_rules.references:
`docs/PROPOSALS.md` model/effort/rationale
the detailed proposal's model header
`docs/PROPOSAL_CREATION_SOP.md` and proposal template if selection rules change
`AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` if agent instructions change
documentation_update_rules.rationale: P-073 found no proposal had an explicit development-agent model. Offline checks now require complete assignments and matching detailed headers; scope and capability judgment remain the author's responsibility
A doc that is not in the index is a doc nobody opens. This rule exists because the index was found 7 files stale on 2026-08-31
The two carry the same policy with agent-specific self-identification; full-file drift is now checked

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a **token, component rule, voice register or consumer** changes in `design-system/`, or a consumer's pointer doc is added or moves
documentation_update_rules.references:
`design-system/crosswalk/consumers.md`
the `design-system` row in `modules/marketing-crosswalk/crosswalk/modules.yml` (`counts`, `consumers`, `files`)
`docs/design/BUILD-PROMPTING-DIGEST.md` and the `design` skill (voice registers)
documentation_update_rules.rationale: Pointer docs are the only way a consumer learns of a hub change, and two copies drift. `tests/design_system/` fails when the registry row, the consumers list, the token counts or the register phrases disagree

documentation_update_rules.trigger: a change that contradicts `roadmap.md`'s layering or ordering
documentation_update_rules.rationale: `CLAUDE.md` §9 requires the entry. Three exist; each was written because the deviation was real, not to justify it afterwards
